title: Satellite Communication In India
definition: Satellite communication in India encompasses the technological ecosystem, institutional framework, and operational fleets managed by ISRO and IN-SPACe to provide nationwide telecommunication, broadcasting, broadband, disaster management support, and strategic military links.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper III (Science and Technology - Awareness in the fields of Space Technology, IT, Space communication, and Applications). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding orbital types, INSAT/GSAT series, and space sector reforms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Satellite Communication In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic physics of orbits (LEO, MEO, GEO)
